description: Delegate a coding task to Nixie, a local AI coding agent working in a project folder. Depending on the permission mode set in Nixie, edits and commands may wait for approval in the Nixie window (never more than auto-edit). Returns Nixie's reply, the files changed and the commands run.

cwd.description: Absolute path of the project folder. Default: the folder the MCP server runs in.

name: nixie_task
